terms.gloss: to hand (a task) over to a machine
evidence: Ter. Ph. 4.4.7: sī quid velīs, huic mandēs (Lewis & Short s.v. mandō)
terms.comment: A description of ours: mandāre, to entrust a task to someone (see leave it to), with the machine as the one entrusted. No reference work has a verb for automating; for work that runs by itself see automatically (suā sponte) and automated testing.

phrases.latin: Hunc labōrem māchinae mandābimus, nē cotīdiē eadem repetāmus.
phrases.english: We’ll automate this job, so that we don’t repeat the same steps every day.

sources: Lewis & Short: mando
